'''Tomorrowland''' was a location advertised on a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] billboard [[Holofeed/Legends|holofeed]].<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
During the [[Incident above Coruscant|Coruscant segment]] of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', a video billboard can be seen advertising "Tomorrowland" in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. [[Disneyland]]'s ''Star Tours'' attraction is located in that park's [[Wikipedia:Tomorrowland|Tomorrowland]] themed area,<ref name="ST2" /> and the original version of the ride at that park was said to launch from the [[Tomorrowland Starport]].<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>
